classGroups.concern: Combine domain mutations with QAction, dialog, warning, plugin-action, canvas, and view wiring.
evidence: Their implementations obtain domain objects through KisViewManager while constructing user actions and presentation objects.

classGroups.concern: Composes document state, image ownership, import-export, file saving, presentation notification, and application lifetime.
evidence: KisDocument.h exposes painting, import-export, QWidget-facing, and serialized feature values while Private constructs all concrete owners.

classGroups.concern: Combines image-layer and linked-file reload behavior with an application command that opens the linked document.
evidence: KisFileLayer derives from the image layer model but calls KisPart and KisDocument to open another document.

classGroups.concern: Presents and edits shared properties across selected nodes through colocated Qt widgets, connectors, adapters, and undo commands.
evidence: kis_multinode_property.h binds QCheckBox and QObject connectors to its concrete node property adapters.

classGroups.concern: Presents, filters, indexes, and styles the document node tree through Qt models.
evidence: The Qt models consume KisNodeManager and command adapters, so relocation must follow their tool-command ownership split.

classGroups.concern: Bridges node and canvas selection presentation to UI-owned node and selection managers.
evidence: The adapters directly wrap KisNodeManager or KisSelectionManager and the panel owns buttons and pointer events.

classGroups.concern: Combines serialized storyboard values and comments with a QPixmap thumbnail used by presentation.
evidence: StoryboardItem stores QPixmap beside values serialized through QDomElement and exposed by KisDocument.

classGroups.concern: Connects selected vector text shapes to canvas text-property resources.
evidence: KisTextPropertiesManager contains selected-shape and canvas-resource signal wiring around text property values.

kisDocumentMethodGroups.concern: Constructs, copies, snapshots, and owns the concrete document object graph.
evidence: KisDocument::Private constructs metadata, presentation, import-export, timers, undo, image, resource storage, and background-save owners.

kisDocumentMethodGroups.concern: Stores document-attached guides, assistants, reference images, storyboard, audio, colors, and measurement values used by serialization and presentation.
evidence: The fields are copied as document data, serialized by format code, and also drive canvas or docker presentation signals.

kisDocumentMethodGroups.concern: Coordinates path opening, import, native loading, and document closing across file, format, and application owners.
evidence: The methods combine concrete path state with KisImportExportManager calls and application-visible completion signals.

kisDocumentMethodGroups.concern: Coordinates save, export, backup, background save, autosave, recovery requests, and completion notification.
evidence: P1 through P3 isolate state, file policy, and presentation while these methods remain the concrete assembly sequence.

kisDocumentMethodGroups.concern: Coordinates serialized metadata and document-owned resource storage used by native files.
evidence: KoDocumentInfo is owned by kritaimpex while KisDocument still composes resource storage and format serialization inputs.

kisDocumentMethodGroups.concern: Exposes path, MIME, modification, recovery, read-write, editing-time, and diagnostic state through the legacy facade.
evidence: Identity, modification, autosave, recovery, and undo state delegate to concrete document session values; wrappers remain for current consumers.

kisDocumentMethodGroups.concern: Owns the current image, shape bridge, image idle behavior, undo connection, and document decorations.
evidence: The methods manipulate KisImage, nodes, shape controllers, painting strokes, and undo adapters while the facade owns their lifetime.

kisDocumentMethodGroups.concern: Builds document captions, previews, paths, and document-information dialogs for presentation.
evidence: The methods return QPixmap or QWidget-facing values and format document state for users without owning file conversion.
Current callers invoke concrete document, tool, and presentation owners directly; no runtime replacement or multiple implementation exists.
Deterministic identity, modification, autosave, recovery, and presentation transitions are extracted; the remaining save sequence coordinates live image and import-export work.
The product has one concrete Qt and KoStore file implementation and current tests require controlled paths rather than a replaceable storage implementation.
The concrete image-layer state and application open action can be separated at application migration without adding a generic port to the image model.

nextAction.purpose: Separate existing tool commands from action, dialog, canvas, node, and selection presentation before relocating dependent document node models.
prerequisites: R1-G6e document classes and KisDocument methods have a recorded owner or later gate.
Tool activation, command, settings, cancellation, and undo boundary contracts are identified before relocation.
completionCriteria: All tool command and settings classes are owned by kritatools or kritatoolsui.
Document presentation models no longer depend on command managers owned by kritaui.
The reviewed kritaui internal references assigned to tools are removed.
nextAction.stopCondition: Stop before input migration if tool activation, settings, cancellation, or undo contracts regress.
